title: Nanopore Native RNA Sequencing of Human Poly(A) Transcriptome
author: Rachael E. Workman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.2.12872/v1
materials: MinION native RNA sequencing of poly-A RNA
RNA extraction and library preparation anticipated yields Figure

steps.title: Culture and Expand GM12878 Cells
steps.instruction: Culture GM12878 cells in RPMI media supplemented with 15% non heat-inactivated FBS and 2mM L-Glutamax.

substeps.instruction: Grow cells to a density of 1E6 / ml.
Dilute ⅓ every ~3 days.
Expand to 9 x T75 flasks (45 ml of media in each).

steps.title: Harvest and Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cells for 10 min at 100 x g (4C), wash in 1/10th volume of PBS (pH 7.4), and combine for homogeneity.

substeps.instruction: Evenly split cells between 8 x 15ml tubes.
Pellet at 100 x g for 10 mins at 4C.
If not proceeding immediately to RNA isolation, snap freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at -80C.

steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Perform RNA extraction using TRI-Reagent and organic phase separation.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 ml of TRI-Reagent to a frozen pellet of 5E7 GM12878 cells and briefly vortex immediately.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add 400 μl BCP (1-Bromo-3-chloro-propane) or 200 μl CHCl3 (Chloroform) per ml of sample.
Vortex, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, briefly vortex again, and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 x g (4C).
Pool the aqueous phase in a LoBind Eppendorf tube and combine with an equal volume of isopropanol.
Mix sample, incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes, and centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12,000 x g (4C).
Remove supernatant and wash RNA pellet with 750 μl 80% ethanol; centrifuge for 5 minutes at 12,000 x g (4C).
Remove supernatant and air dry pellet for 10 minutes.
Resuspend in nuclease free water (100 μl final volume).
Quantify with Qubit or Nanodrop and either store at -80C or proceed to poly-A purification.

steps.title: Purify Poly(A) RNA
steps.instruction: Select poly-A RNA from total RNA aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 100 μg aliquots of total RNA in 100 μl of nuclease free water.
Perform poly-A selection using NEXTflex Poly(A) Beads.
Elute resulting mRNA in Nuclease free water and store at -80oC.

steps.title: Synthesize First Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform first strand cDNA synthesis and strand-switching.

substeps.instruction: Combine 100 ng of poly-A purified RNA with 0.5 ng of the SIRV set 3 control.
Perform synthesis using Superscript IV.
Perform reverse transcription and strand-switching using primers provided by ONT in the SQK-PCS108 kit.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using LongAmp Taq Master Mix.

substeps.instruction: Set PCR cycles: 15 cycles when using the SQK-PCS108 kit, or 11 cycles when using the SQK-LSK308 kit.
Run thermal cycler: 95C for 30 seconds, then the specified number of cycles (95C for 15 seconds, 62C for 15 seconds, 65C for 15 minutes), followed by 65C for 15 minutes, and hold at 4C.
Purify PCR products using 0.8X AMPure XP beads and elute in nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Prepare Direct RNA Sequencing Library
steps.instruction: Prepare biological poly-A RNA and synthetic control for nanopore direct RNA sequencing following the ONT SQK-RNA001 kit protocol.

substeps.instruction: Use 500-775 ng of biological poly-A RNA and 5 ng of synthetic control (Lexogen SIRV Set 3).
Include the optional reverse transcription step recommended by ONT.
Replace the recommended Superscript III with Superscript IV for reverse transcription.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA Sequencing Library
steps.instruction: Prepare cDNA sequencing libraries using 1 μg of cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Follow the standard ONT protocol for SQK-PCS108 (1D sequencing) or SQK-LSK308 (1D^2 sequencing).
Use 0.8X AMPure XP beads for cleanup instead of the recommended 0.4X.
